物理列の都合で概念が歪み、後からの変更コストが跳ね上がる。: Concepts are distorted by physical column constraints, and the cost of later changes skyrockets.
概念モデルが安定してから物理ソースへバインドする。: Bind to the physical source only after the conceptual model is stable.
すべての Entity Type にキーがあり、キーが一意である。: Every Entity Type has a key, and the key is unique.
すべての Relationship に方向・カーディナリティ・否定的意味が宣言さ: Every Relationship has direction, cardinality, and negative meaning declared.
外部キーが解決でき、件数が期待値と一致する。: Foreign keys can be resolved, and record counts match the expected values.
代表的な多段経路が意図どおり辿れる。: Representative multi-hop traversal paths can be followed as intended.
曖昧語（同名・同義語）が ID で解決できる。: Ambiguous terms (same name, synonyms) can be resolved by ID.
モデル外の質問に対して、境界を答えられる。: For questions outside the model, the boundary can be stated.
4. Furusato Ontology の設計根拠: 4. Design rationale for the Furusato Ontology
第 3 章の手順を、このワークショップのドメインに適用した結果が次のモデルです。: The following model is the result of applying the procedures from Chapter 3 to the domain of this workshop. We explain why this form was chosen, together with the options that were not selected.
上段が「基幹エンティティ / Core entities (7)」（マスタ 6: The upper band is "基幹エンティティ / Core entities (7)" (6 master + 1 transaction) and the lower band is "集計層 / Metric / Flow entities (3)". It shows the 15 directed Relationships and the time-series binding that only Municipality has.
Furusato Ontology の全体図。上段の帯は「基幹エンティティ Co: Overview diagram of the Furusato Ontology. The upper band, "基幹エンティティ Core entities (7)", holds the six master types Prefecture, Municipality, Donor, GiftCategory, Gift and Supplier plus the single transaction type Donation, joined by directed arrows. The lower band, "集計層 Metric / Flow entities (3)", holds MunicipalityCategoryMetric, PrefectureCategoryMetric and PrefectureDonationFlow, connected to the core entities along separate paths. Arrows show the direction of all 15 Relationships. Only Municipality has a time-series binding from the Eventhouse, drawn as an orange dashed line. No relationship connects Donor and Supplier directly; that is negated with a red dashed line and a cross. The valid paths are Supplier to Gift, Donation to Gift, and Donor to Donation.
10 の Entity Type は 7 + 3 に分かれます。7 は基幹エンテ: The 10 Entity Types divide into 7 + 3. The 7 form the core entity layer (master 6 + transaction 1): 6 master types (Prefecture, Municipality, Donor, GiftCategory, Gift, Supplier) and 1 transaction type (Donation). The remaining 3 form the aggregate layer: 2 metric types with pre-aggregations at composite grain, and 1 flow type with direction (MunicipalityCategoryMetric, PrefectureCategoryMetric, PrefectureDonationFlow). This 7 + 3 division is the baseline for every subsequent decision — where to count and what not to add together.
10 Entity Type の 7 + 3 の内訳: Breakdown of the 10 Entity Types into 7 + 3
Prefecture、Municipality、Donor、GiftCatego: Prefecture, Municipality, Donor, GiftCategory, Gift, Supplier
件数と金額の唯一の正式な集計経路: The only authoritative aggregation path for counts and amounts
複合粒度の事前集計値（再集計しない）: Pre-aggregated values at a composite grain (never re-aggregated)
10 Entity Type の選定理由: Selection rationale for the 10 Entity Types
全国 47 の行政区分。受入側と在住側の 2 つの読み方を 1 つのエンティティ: All 47 administrative divisions nationwide. A single entity retains both the recipient-side and residence-side readings as distinct.
寄付の受入先であり、返礼品カタログの主体でもある。唯一 time-series: The recipient of donations and the primary subject of the return gift catalog. Also serves as the sole key for time-series observations.
寄付の主体。合成データだが、人物に関する推論は行わない境界を明示する。: The subject of donations. Although synthetic data, it explicitly marks the boundary: no inferences about individuals are drawn.
返礼品の分類。カテゴリ単位の分析要求が多いため独立させる。: Classification of return gifts. Kept independent because analysis requests at the category level are frequent.
返礼品そのもの。自治体がカタログ登録し、寄付が選択する対象。: The return gift itself. Registered in the catalog by the municipality and selected by the donation.
返礼品を供給する事業者。カタログ登録の主体であり、履行の主体ではない。: The supplier that provides return gifts. The primary party for catalog registration, not for fulfillment.
唯一のトランザクション粒度。ID・金額・時刻・支払方法・寄付者・受入先・選択返礼: The sole transaction grain. Carries ID, amount, timestamp, payment method, donor, recipient, and selected return gift.
自治体 × カテゴリという複合粒度の事前集計。明細からの再集計を防ぐ。: Pre-aggregation at the composite grain of municipality × category. Prevents re-aggregation from detail records.
都道府県（受入側）× カテゴリの複合粒度の事前集計。: Pre-aggregation at the composite grain of prefecture (recipient side) × category.
居住地都道府県 → 受入先都道府県のフロー。方向を持つ集計を独立させる。: Flow from residence prefecture → recipient prefecture. Keeps directional aggregation independent.
Donation は、安定した DonationId、金額、時刻、支払方法を持ち: Donation has a stable DonationId, amount, timestamp, and payment method, and is the sole point where the three concepts of Donor, Municipality, and Gift intersect. Folding it as an attribute into another entity would make it impossible to simultaneously answer the three directional questions of "who," "to where," and "what was selected." Donation is therefore an independent transaction Entity and the sole transaction grain in this model.
件数と金額の正式な集計経路は Donation です。ほかのエンティティが持つ: The official aggregation path for count and amount is Donation. The StaticCount/TotalYen-type Properties held by other entities are pre-aggregations at their respective grains and must not be re-aggregated across different scopes.
4.3 なぜ business_gifts は Entity ではないのか: 4.3 Why business_gifts is not an Entity
配布される `business_gifts.csv` は `BusinessID: The distributed `business_gifts.csv` is a bridge with only 2 columns, `BusinessID` and `GiftID`. The rows themselves have no name, state, or lifecycle, and there is no need to refer to "that registration" in business conversation. It is therefore not made into an Entity but used as the context table for the Relationship named SupplierProvidesGift. The edge count is 14,514.
`business_gifts.csv` と発行後テーブルの列名は同じではない: Column names in `business_gifts.csv` and in the published table are not the same
元システムの命名。事業者は Business と呼ばれている。: Naming from the source system. The supplier is called Business.
Ontology の語彙に合わせて Supplier へ改名し、Id 表記も統一: Renamed to Supplier to align with the Ontology vocabulary, with Id notation also standardized.
第 9 章で入力するのはこちらの列名。: These are the column names entered in Chapter 9.
第 9 章で Mapping table に `ot_supplier_gift: When specifying `ot_supplier_gift` in the Mapping table in Chapter 9, the Matched keys are `SupplierId` and `GiftId`. Entering the CSV's `BusinessID` / `GiftID` will result in columns not being found. Even the "same thing in business terms" can change its name when the layer changes.
この橋は多対多です。1 つの Gift に複数の Supplier が登録されて: This bridge is many-to-many. When multiple Suppliers are registered for a single Gift, aggregating DonationAmountYen across the bridge causes double-counting. Aggregating amounts along this path is prohibited unless an explicit allocation rule exists.
4.4 なぜ Donor と Supplier を直接つながないのか: 4.4 Why Donor and Supplier are not connected directly
「この寄付者はどの事業者から返礼品を受け取ったか」という質問は自然に見えますが、: The question "which supplier did this donor receive the return gift from?" looks natural, but that fact does not exist in this dataset. The only indirect path that is modeled is the following.
Ontology のトラバース経路（カタログ登録と返礼品選択のみを証明する）: Ontology traversal path (proves catalog registration and return-gift selection only)
この経路が証明するのは「その事業者がその返礼品をカタログ登録している」ことと「そ: What this path proves is only that "the supplier has catalog-registered that return gift" and that "the donation selected that return gift." It does not identify the shipping origin. Creating a direct Donor–Supplier relationship would erase this distinction and cause the agent to assert fulfillment.
「東京の寄付」は 2 通りに読めます。受入（その都道府県の自治体が受け取った寄付: "Tokyo donations" can be read in two ways: recipient (donations received by municipalities in that prefecture) and resident (donations made by donors living in that prefecture). This model retains both as separate paths and separate Properties.
2 つの値は別の意味を持つため、決して足し合わせません。曖昧な質問に対しては、両: The two values have different meanings and must never be added together. For ambiguous questions, the correct behavior is to present both values or to confirm which meaning is intended.
4.6 なぜ Municipality だけが 2 つのバインディングを持つのか: 4.6 Why only Municipality has two bindings
運用観測（8 月の増分）には Donor も Gift も Supplier も: The operational observation (August increment) does not include Donor, Gift, or Supplier. It contains only the recipient municipality, amount, timestamp, and execution metadata. Municipality is therefore the sole entity to which the observation can be connected. By binding the observation as a time-axis measurement to the existing Municipality rather than creating a new entity, the operational movement can be observed without polluting the static snapshot counts.
受入側の行政包含。受入地理をたどる唯一の経路。: Administrative containment on the recipient side. The sole path for traversing recipient geography.
寄付者の居住地。受入地理とは別の意味を持つため分離する。: Donor's place of residence. Kept separate because it has a different meaning from recipient geography.
事業者の所在地。寄付の受入先とは無関係であることを明示する。: Supplier's location. Explicitly indicates that it is unrelated to the donation recipient.
返礼品の分類。カテゴリ集計の入口。: Classification of return gifts. The entry point for category aggregation.
自治体によるカタログ掲載。受入金額の集計経路ではない。: Catalog listing by municipality. Not the aggregation path for received amounts.
事業者によるカタログ登録。多対多のため金額集計を禁止する。: Catalog registration by supplier. Amount aggregation is prohibited because of the many-to-many relationship.
寄付の実行主体。金額集計は Donation 側で行う。: The executing party of the donation. Amount aggregation is performed on the Donation side.
受入先の確定経路。受入件数・金額の正式な集計経路。: The definitive path to the recipient. The official aggregation path for recipient count and amount.
選択された返礼品。購入・発送ではない。: The selected return gift. Not a purchase or shipment.
自治体から複合粒度メトリックへの入口。: Entry point from municipality to composite-grain metrics.
複合粒度メトリックからカテゴリへの参照。: Reference from composite-grain metrics to category.
受入都道府県から複合粒度メトリックへの入口。: Entry point from recipient prefecture to composite-grain metrics.
居住地側（フローの起点）。方向を持つ集計の入口。: Residence side (flow origin). Entry point for directional aggregation.
受入側（フローの終点）。起点と終点を入れ替えない。: Recipient side (flow destination). Do not swap origin and destination.
モデルは「何を主張するか」と同じくらい「何を主張しないか」が重要です。次の表は、: A model's "what it does not assert" is just as important as "what it asserts." The following table lists the interpretations that this Ontology explicitly rejects. The same boundaries are written into the Data Agent instructions.

静的 Donation の件数・金額には加算しない。Donor / Gift /: Never added to static Donation counts or amounts, and it identifies no Donor, Gift or Supplier. No deduplication is applied (deduplication = none), so rows with duplicate EventIDs remain in the total. Never treat it as deduplicated or as a confirmed value.
